evidence.question: Is the dividend safe?
evidence.text: Short answer: The data shows a dividend that looks well covered by earnings and supported by a healthy balance sheet, but its headline size has already been reduced once (the large performance‑linked add‑ons disappeared after 2024/25), and the coverage inputs that matter most — payout ratio, cash flow, net margin, interest coverage — are not published here, so "safety" can't be confirmed from this database P1Key metrics DB.What the numbers show (Saudi Aramco, 2222, SAR): P1Key metricsCoverage by earnings: the last four declared quarterly DPS are SAR 0.34, 0.34, 0.34 and 0.33, totalling SAR 1.35, against trailing EPS of SAR 1.84 DBP1Key metrics — roughly 73% of earnings. The payout ratio itself is not published in the fundamentals (it lists as missing inputs) DB.Cash being paid out: each recent quarter runs about SAR 82,060–82,080 million, versus SAR 116,450–116,510 million in the 2024 quarters DB. Market cap is SAR 6,117,760 million, so a year of dividends is a small slice of the equity value P1Key metrics.Direction of travel: the base component has been nudged up (0.33 in 2025 → 0.34 in the Q1 and Q2 2026 declarations), but the performance‑linked element shrank from SAR 40,390–40,410 million per quarter (2024) to SAR 820 million per quarter (2025) and is absent from the 2026 notes DB. On a trailing four‑quarter basis that is a step down from SAR 1.77 to SAR 1.35 per share.Profitability and balance sheet behind it: ROE 26.75%, ROA 15.86%, debt/equity 0.20 (54th sector percentile), current ratio 2.00 (68.7th sector percentile), health score 61.35 DB.Yield today: 5.23% at the SAR 25.48 close of 2026-10-20, with the income seat voting bullish (yield above its 5% threshold) and the risk seat bullish (1‑year volatility 14.8%) P1Key metricsDB.What is not available here: payout ratio, free cash flow yield, interest coverage, net margin, gross margin and ROIC all come back as missing or not applicable for this sector, and no forward dividend policy or guidance statement is in the feed DB. News and disclosures are also stale — dated 2026-03-09 against a 30‑ and 120‑day window — and the news seat abstained because there is no rated item in the last 30 days, so nothing in the data flags an announced cut or change P1Key metricsDB.Read together: earnings and balance‑sheet metrics do not strain the current SAR 0.34 quarterly rate, but the record shows the company has already trimmed the variable layer, and the cash‑flow evidence needed to call the dividend fully safe is not in this database DB.Saudi Aramco (2222) dividend history, SAR per shareget_dividends(2222)Pin to dashboardEx-datePeriodDPS (SAR)Total (SAR mn)Note2026-08-19Q2 20260.3482,060no performance-linked component2026-06-01Q1 20260.3482,080no performance-linked component2026-03-16Q4 20250.3482,080no performance-linked component2025-11-17Q3 20250.3380,120incl. performance-linked SAR 820 mn2025-08-19Q2 20250.3380,110incl. performance-linked SAR 820 mn2025-05-21Q1 20250.3380,110incl. performance-linked SAR 820 mn2025-03-17Q4 20240.3380,100incl. performance-linked SAR 820 mn2024-11-14Q3 20240.48116,450incl. performance-linked SAR 40,390 mn2024-08-20Q2 20240.48116,450incl. performance-linked SAR 40,390 mn2024-05-14Q1 20240.48116,510incl. performance-linked SAR 40,410 mn
